For turbine engine bleed air systems, the following applies:
(a) No major or more serious event may result if duct rupture or failure occurs anywhere between the engine port and the UAV unit served by the bleed air.
(b) Engine performance degradation shall be quantified as a function of bleed air usage.
(c) Not applicable.
(d) Adequate compartment ventilation must be provided for cooling hot duct surfaces where the Auto- Ignition Temperature (AIT)of combustible materials is exceeded.
(e) Ducts whose surface temperature exceeds the AIT must be insulated such that the outside surface temperature is less than AIT.
(f) The design must prohibit combustible fluids from direct impingement on duct surfaces.
